record.title: Integrative multi-omic analyses identify major axes of heterogeneity in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease and uncover their molecular contributors - ECLIPSE replication cohort
record.description: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) is a complex, heterogeneous disease. record.description: The physiology of trabecular meshwork (TM) controls aqueous humor outflow resistance and thereby intraocular pressure (IOP), a major risk factor for primary open-angle glaucoma (POAG).
